description: The TypeError of EscaperNodeVisitor::needEscaping() through an Environment. {% autoescape null %} around a print, a block or a block reference makes needEscaping(): string|bool fail its return type check (a TypeError; EscaperNodeVisitor.php is not strict, so numbers and true are coerced to strings). compileSource() catches only Twig errors and \Exception, so load() throws the TypeError itself, also for a template whose traits ({% use %}) fail to compile, as the constructor loads them; a template that loads the broken one while rendering (include, embed, extends, import, from, block(), include(), template_from_string()) wraps it in a RuntimeError of the rendering at the line of the loading tag. Controls: autoescape null without a print, an inner autoescape false, embeds and includes inside it, number and true strategies. The oracle ran every case in its own PHP process with a filesystem cache of its own (batch need_escaping_env.gen.json, "isolation": "process"). Record again with: twig-fuzz record tests/vectors/visitors/need_escaping_env.gen.json --out <file> --description <text>.
